title: Derived Stein splitting near geometrically reduced fibres of proper flat families
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must split the zero-degree piece of derived pushforward while ensuring the remaining piece has positive Tor amplitude. It proves fibrewise section surjectivity by passing to an algebraically closed residue field and lifting fibre idempotents, then identifies the zero-degree algebra as finite etale on a neighbourhood.
